original_row.subject: thm-randomized-history-dag-expected-location-cost
original_row.evidence: Read all six steps, exact four suppliers and history-DAG procedure, and de Berg Chapter 9 pp. 204–208, Lemmas 9.11/9.13 and Theorem 9.12, including the full conflict-count argument. Corrected step 1.1 to bound conditional expected degree, not every sampled vertex degree; the explicit subsequent expectation argument was already correct. Clarified the step-1.2 sum as final new triangles T_r minus T_(r-1), excluding temporary legalization triangles, which are charged separately in step 2.1. Under uniform prefix conditioning, each triangle has probability <=3/r of incidence to the last site; next-site conflicts count exactly destroyed old lower triangles, and expected final new degree <=12 gives 36(n-r)/r. Temporary nodes receive at most two charges per old destroyed triangle. Harmonic summation gives expected O(n log n) walks and O(n) nodes; O(r) worst-case new nodes per stage gives O(n^3) walks. Fixed augmented general position, exact-call model, valid passed face certificates and exclusion of supertriangle search/bit costs checked. No AC and no adversarial-order expectation asserted.

Under uniform prefix conditioning, each triangle has probability <=3/r of incidence to the last site; next-site conflicts count exactly destroyed old lower triangles, and expected final new degree <=12 gives 36(n-r)/r.
